messages:
alina: quick FYI, noticed the generate API examples show `files: null` in one place and `files: []` in another. Customers copy these; we should be consistent.
tom: Good catch. Runtime accepts both, but we prefer [] in examples to avoid null serialization issues in some SDKs.
alina: I'll open a small PR to make all examples use [] and add a 1-liner explanation.
pr-bot: CI ok for docs PR #1543 (docs/generate.md) — change null -> [] in examples.
tom: Can you also update the Ruby example? It currently uses nil.
alina: Yup, updated Ruby to use [] and added a curl snippet showing files: []. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1543
docs-bot: Checklist: examples normalized, SDK snippet updated, reviewers: @tom.
tom: LGTM, merging. I'll ping release-notes for a short blurb recommending [] for empty lists in new clients.
alina: Thanks!
